text: Underway in round eleven.
Abyss shouts to claim the ball.
Signal has broken clean through the middle here, entirely on their own!
Agonisingly wide from point-blank range. That was a golden opportunity to start things off.
The push-panel does its work, thumping the magenta ball back into open territory from three metres out.
Another corner panel rattles it clear.
DeepSeek have named an unchanged side today, and you can hear Abyss calling clearly to take charge of it in their own third.
Heavy challenge on the touchline by Signal, leaving Zidroid sprawled on the deck.
Abyss loses footing in defence.
CR-7000 strikes! Real Machina lead one-nil from right in front!
Abyss topples over again straight from the restart, having a torrid couple of minutes.
Abyss gets back upright and calls out to take possession along the right touchline.
CR-7000 is clean through again!
Charging eight metres straight up the right channel with real intent.
CR-7000 tucks it away calmly from two metres out. Real Machina double their advantage, making it two-nil.
Just wide of the upright.
Abyss makes amends instantly! Smashed home from point-blank range, and DeepSeek Rovers are right back in this at two-one!
Inches wide of the target!
Abyss driving straight through the middle.
Oh, catastrophe for Real Machina! CR-7000 has turned it into their own net, and we are level at two-two!
Signal takes a tumble along the left touchline, but the motors are already whirring to right themselves.
Zidroid bursts through from deep, completely clear of the blue shirts!
Abyss calls the defensive cover.
CR-7000 takes over, advancing through the centre circle towards the attacking third.
Just skimming the wrong side!
CR-7000 restores the lead! A clinical finish on the stroke of half-time makes it three-two to Real Machina!
A clumsy tangle of white shirts.
And now Zidroid hits the deck as the Real Machina pair collide for a second time in midfield.
CR-7000 calls out that the ball is trapped against the wall, stepping in to work it loose.
Signal crunches into Zidroid.
The buzzer sounds, power is cut, but the ball rolls freely on.

The ball stops, and that is half-time. For newcomers, the buzzer cuts power instantly to all robots, but the ball stays live until it stops moving. If it rolls in, it counts. Three-two to Real Machina.
A quiet restart. Real Machina, of course, run without a gaffer, relying entirely on live model calls touch by touch. It makes for wonderfully unpredictable passages of play.
Real Machina are hemming Rovers into their own end here, applying relentless pressure.
Abyss is away on the break!
Dribbling three metres down the left channel, looking to haul Rovers level.
Zidroid informs their teammate the ball is wedged on the boards and hooks it out.
Abyss levels the match! Poked home from right on the goal line, and DeepSeek make it three-three!
Abyss calls loudly to take ownership of the ball over on the right channel.
Zidroid strikes! That is thirty-one for the season, putting Real Machina ahead four-three!
CR-7000 topples over in the centre circle.
CR-7000 leaps up and flattens Signal with a crunching tackle in the defensive third.
Zidroid surges right into the goalmouth!
Zidroid doubles their tally in seconds! It is five-three to Real Machina!
More friendly fire in white as CR-7000 goes down again.
Signal calls that they are covering.
Abyss works the right channel, pressing into the final third with time ticking away.
Signal pulls one back! Squeezed in from point-blank range, and DeepSeek Rovers trail by just one, five-four!
CR-7000 clean through on goal in the corner!
CR-7000 scores! What a vital finish with under a minute left, making it six-four!
Abyss replies instantly! This match is unhinged! Six-five, and Rovers have thirty seconds left!
Inches wide of the post! DeepSeek so close to a frantic equaliser!
The push-panel fires it back across the face of goal!
Buzzer sounds, power cut, robots fold, but the ball is trundling towards goal!
It rolls safely to a halt. Real Machina survive six-five. Up next, GLM against Singularity United: Tuesday, midday UK, thirteen
